raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly persisted the claim of a birth-date discrepancy for Jorge Brum do Canto after the latest WebSurfer result had already resolved it (Wikipedia showing 10 February 1910). This failure to update and reconcile new, more authoritative information led to unnecessary repetition and could have driven a wrong conclusion (favoring Monte Hellman’s 1929 as “earlier” over the mistakenly cited 1930), rather than correctly recognizing Brum do Canto’s 1910 birth year.
